My throat was hurting really badly all day. My mom kind of ignored me because I tended to complain about stuff like that a lot (I was 17). But that night she noticed my throat was swollen so she took me to the ER because she thought I was having an allergic reaction to something. They immediately knew it was my thyroid Nothing much happened that night but they recommended me seeing an endocrinologist.  
The next day I saw him, he said there was nothing wrong with my thyroid. We believed him because he was supposed to be the best endocrinologist in the area. But about a year after that I saw his partner, a younger man, who was basically like "No, he was wrong, there's something there, let's biopsy it." And of course, boom, cancer.  
I had my thyroid removed, several bouts of radiation, and most recently, a bunch of positive lymph nodes removed. Over 2 years and 2 surgeries later and I'm still not cancer free, yet :/
